purpose: Keep durable user-owned state independent of any single model, hosting provider or semantic-memory service.

optional_backends.purpose: Version selected durable workspace files locally without requiring a specific remote hosting provider.
Improve semantic recall and wake-up context when available.

rules: The user-owned workspace files are the minimum durable state required for core operation.
Semantic memory may index or retrieve state but must not become the only copy of durable state.
Semantic-memory provider commands must stay behind the replaceable adapter interface.
Git may version selected durable state but the core must not depend on GitHub or any other specific remote host.
Git transport must not automatically create, choose, or push to a remote host.
Optional backend failure must be reported and must not block startup when local workspace state is valid.
A backend may be replaced without changing the state-routing destinations defined by the core.
